purpose: FOCUS training stability diagnosis on two independently initialized domains; not sequential CL and not a final ablated method
site_selection: stream endpoints chosen before results of this experiment; independent single-domain training
data: same source/shared order and HDF5 integer-truncated labels; first val block selects earliest best, remaining val blocks evaluation; no test

variants.full_sgd: complete single-domain FOCUS training: CCD .9, GIN .5, SGD .01 momentum .99 Nesterov wd3e-5 poly.9
variants.no_ccd: only bypass CCD output; still generate same masks to preserve RNG consumption
variants.no_gin: only bypass GIN output; still generate GIN to preserve RNG consumption
variants.full_adam: keep CCD/GIN fully, replace optimizer package with Adam2e-4 wd3e-5 same poly.9; LR borrowed from existing ResUNet medical runs, not official FOCUS setting; no LR grid

analysis: all16 complete before cross2domain/2seed comparisons; no_ccd/no_gin are diagnostic only; evaluate train-loss/gradient clipping/selection and heldout val, no seed selection
limitations: no replay or freeze stage in independent first-task diagnosis; cannot establish sequential benefit
two selected metadata domains not proof of independent patients
same initial seed/model/draw consumption where intervention permits, GPU differences not bitwise promise
failure: any failed arm stops running arms and queued successors; preserve evidence; no blind retries

requirements: all four paired heldout validation differences positive versus full_sgd
lower mean gradient clipping fraction over first10epochs
prospective_sequential_gate.if_passed: fresh two-seed six-domain50epoch validation changing only optimizer and baseLR; same old stream, backbone, data and inference; compare with preserved shared-backbone control
prospective_sequential_gate.if_not_passed: inspect complete mechanism evidence; do not launch automatic LR search
